name: rolling-number
title: Rolling number
description: The Satin Pro Rolling number component.

RollingNumber.description: The digits of `text`, rolling from the old to the new when they differ. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `span`.

props.name: text
props.description: The number as shown, already formatted ("1,204").

props.name: value
props.description: The number itself: which way the digits roll.
